output: html_document

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

1. open the starwars dataset in tidyverse
```{r}
data("starwars")
```


2. create a graph showing the frequency of eye colors in the dataset. 
```{r}
library("jtools")

ggplot(starwars, aes(eye_color))+geom_bar()

```

3. Customize your graph to make it more presentable. Consider color, backgrounds, axes, etc. 
```{r}
ggplot(starwars, aes(eye_color))+geom_bar(fill= "navyblue", color = "gray")+theme_apa()+xlab("X-axis: Eye Color")+ylab("Y-axis: Count")+ggtitle("Frequency of Eye Colors")

```


4. Create a graph displaying information about character's height in each homeworld. 
```{r}

ggplot(starwars, aes(x = homeworld, y = height))+geom_boxplot()+geom_jitter()+theme_apa()
```

5. Customize your graph to make it more presentable. Consider color, backgrounds, axes, etc.
```{r}
ggplot(starwars, aes(x = homeworld, y = height))+geom_boxplot(fill= "skyblue", color = "black")+geom_jitter(color = "navyblue")+theme_apa()+xlab("X-axis: Homeworld Locations")+ylab("Y-axis: Height")+ggtitle("Height in Each Homeworld")
```

6. Create a graph of character's height by mass. 
```{r}
ggplot(starwars, aes(x = mass, y = height))+geom_point(na.rm = TRUE)+theme_apa()
```

7.Customize your graph to make it more presentable. Consider color, backgrounds, axes, etc.
```{r}
ggplot(starwars, aes(x = mass, y = height))+geom_point(color = "#FF7F24", na.rm = TRUE)+theme_apa()+xlab("X-axis: Mass")+ylab("Y-axis: Height")+ggtitle("Relationship Between Height and Mass")
```

8. Add gender as a third variable to your graph of height by mass. 
```{r}
ggplot(starwars, aes(x = mass, y = height))+geom_point(aes(color = gender), na.rm = TRUE)
```

9. Customize your graph to make it more presentable. Consider color, backgrounds, axes, etc.
```{r}
ggplot(starwars, aes(x = mass, y = height))+geom_point(aes(color = gender), na.rm = TRUE)+scale_color_manual(values = c("feminine" = "#FF69B4", "masculine" = "#1874CD"))+ theme_classic()+xlab("X-axis: Mass")+ylab("Y-axis: Height")+ggtitle("Relationship Between Height and Mass (Feminine vs. Masculine)")
```
